scripts/commit-when-clean.mjs keeps the prepared patch's order (stage, verify, sample, commit the index) and adds one behaviour the patch lacked: every refusal after staging restores the index with git read-tree of the tree git write-tree recorded before staging, so a refused commit leaves the index as the old order left it. When write-tree cannot record the index (unresolved conflicts) the refusal says the changes were left staged.

The new commit-gate case narrows the verifier to one real guard (A1-257-9's case in test-kits/app-boundaries.test.mjs, which reads git ls-files) because the whole check contains ratchets-bite.test.mjs and re-enters itself. The narrowed verifier prints the clean line only when that run exits 0 having passed a test; it does not import verify-clean-run.mjs's decide, because importing that script runs the coverage-floor guard, which refuses the copy's edited package.json.

security_privacy_cost_impact: Narrows a local gap: the commit gate now verifies the index it commits. No credential, customer data, provider call or dependency. The new test copies the repository into the system temporary directory and gives the copy its own git directory, so neither commit-gate case can stage into the checkout the suite runs from.
compatibility_impact: No contract changes. commit-when-clean's exit codes and messages are kept; a refusal now restores the index rather than leaving it untouched by never staging, and the old 'changed while staging' refusal is gone because staging comes first.
known_limitations: A write that lands between the commit gate's second tree sample and git commit is not in the index and is left out of the commit, not refused; the gate cannot see it.

git status --porcelain shows a staged rename as 'old -> new', so a rename unstaged at the first sample still reads as a moved tree after staging and is refused with 92; this was true of the old post-staging sample too and is not changed here.
The new commit-gate case pins the order against one guard that reads the index, not the whole check.
